cpu_scope.continuity: Every next helper before-sample equals the previous after-cleanup sample; every target before-reap equals its helper after-sample.
cpu_scope.limits: Offline verification binds records and exact frozen program bytes. It does not perform an independent live /proc observation.

interpretation.attribution: Native CANCEL ratios include candidate effects and process/run variation; do not attribute the entire measured difference to lazy import.
interpretation.control: READ source and timed scripts are byte-identical. READ movement is control variation, not an optimization gain.
interpretation.environment_boundary: A deliberately unavailable unused subprocess module may now allow exited/Linux paths to proceed. This intentional incomplete-standard-library difference is reported separately, not hidden as semantic equivalence.
interpretation.mock: All 28 mock helpers are branch semantics only. No mock record enters performance statistics.
interpretation.module_timing: The atexit module snapshot is not an import trace. Mock faults may terminate before CANCEL imports or finish after exception handling. The source of additional subprocess loading in three uncaught mock-error cases was not traced and remains unknown; those observations enter no performance gate.
interpretation.scope: A component CPU mechanism screen, not runtime adoption, SSH throughput, multi-host capacity or memory improvement.

memory.scope: Cumulative Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss across reaped helpers and targets; neither per-helper RSS nor traced allocation.
